SUPERSEDED, and left here rather than deleted because the INCIDENT is still true and worth reading: the .cmd-suffix fix described above was itself incomplete. It appended .cmd to every command including git, which has no git.cmd, so the branch step failed silently and adoption committed straight to the default branch — and naming a .cmd correctly still does not let Node spawn one (CVE-2024-27980). _why_auto_mjs_214_to: plugins/harness-core/lib/auto.mjs 214 → 220. The .cmd suffix answered only half the trap and broke git doing it. The single run() now routes every command through cmd.exe on win32, which resolves a bare name via PATHEXT (git.exe, npm.cmd, or a launcher's .cmd twin) and runs a .cmd the one way Node cannot; the extra lines are the explanation of both traps. Do not recover them by reintroducing the .cmd-suffix guess, which cannot tell git from npm, or by passing shell true, which shell-interprets every argument.

The rest of the growth is the refusal message, which now names what to do next instead of only what is wrong — a new contributor meeting a red gate alone in their first week is the failure mode this whole change is defending against, and a refusal that ends without a next step is where it starts. descriptor.mjs gained docsDir and ideasFile because the zoning table reads them and this module is the single place descriptor defaults are allowed to live; putting them anywhere else is the six-copy bug that module was created to end. _why_disclosure_guard: principals.mjs, standing.mjs and crossing.mjs all grew for one reason: a fresh adopter's .harness/ is NOT gitignored. The harness was treating a property of ITS OWN repo as a property of the adopter's. rosterState() now distinguishes ABSENT from EXPOSED and refuses to read in the second case, and the roster schema is CLOSED to exactly {id, kind, tier, identities} so a well-meant free-text note beside a person's name has nowhere to live — you cannot leak a field no code reads. Do not recover these lines by collapsing exposed back into absent, or by widening the projection.
_why_dispatch_mjs_69_to: plugins/harness-gates/lib/dispatch.mjs 69 → 76. dispatch's tool() spawns the sibling launchers (harness-fleet, harness-claim) to acquire a slot and territory in one breath. _why_privacy_rail: preflight.mjs 144 → 167, standing.mjs 106 → 116, campaigns.mjs 115 → 123.
